title: Measurement
description: Immutable record of a single feed quality test. Contains all 15 parameters from Table 4.1, confidence intervals, and derived outputs. Append-only — never updated after creation.

feed_type.description: FeedType enum key. Determines which sub-model was active during inference.

device_sku.description: DeviceSKU enum key. Determines which parameters are populated vs null.

scan_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time from scan start to spectrum transfer complete, in milliseconds.

inference_duration_ms.description: Total on-device ML inference time across all models, in milliseconds.

environment.description: Ambient conditions from BME688 at time of scan. Used for spectral compensation.

voc_index.description: BME688 VOC index 0–500. Null if sensor not warmed up.

proximates.description: Proximate analysis results. All values on dry-matter basis unless noted.

moisture_pct.description: Moisture as % of fresh weight. Model: PLS-R 12LV. Target RMSEP: ±1.2%

crude_protein_pct_dm.description: Crude protein % DM (N×6.25). Model: 1D-CNN+PLS ensemble. Target RMSEP: ±1.5%

adf_pct_dm.description: Acid detergent fibre % DM. Model: PLS-R. Target RMSEP: ±2.1%

ndf_pct_dm.description: Neutral detergent fibre % DM. Model: PLS-R. Target RMSEP: ±2.6%

crude_fat_pct_dm.description: Ether extract / crude fat % DM. Target RMSEP: ±0.8%. Null for AAHAR Lite on certain feeds.

ash_pct_dm.description: Total mineral / ash % DM. Target RMSEP: ±1.1%

me_mj_kg_dm.description: Metabolisable energy MJ/kg DM. Derived from CP/ADF/EE/Ash via MAFF equations. Target RMSEP: ±0.6 MJ

ca_p_status.description: Calcium/Phosphorus status from camera-read colorimetric strip. 3-class, F1 ≥ 0.85. Null if strip not used.

ca_p_confidence.description: Model confidence for Ca/P classification. Null if ca_p_status is null.

safety.description: Food safety and adulteration screening results.

verdict.description: Overall adulteration verdict. SUSPECT if any single adulterant confidence 0.5–0.8, ADULTERATED if > 0.8.

urea.description: Urea adulteration detection. F1 ≥ 0.93 at ≥1% w/w. Null if device not capable.

estimated_pct.description: Rough estimated % w/w. Only shown with screening disclaimer. Null if not detected.

strip_confirmed.description: Urease strip confirmation via camera vision. Null if strip not used.

melamine_npn.description: Melamine/NPN anomaly detection via autoencoder. AUC ≥ 0.88. AAHAR Pro only.

anomaly_score.description: Reconstruction error normalised to [0, inf]. > threshold_melamine_anomaly flags as suspect.

mycotoxin.description: Mycotoxin screening. Screening only — never quantitative. AAHAR Pro only.

lab_referral_required.description: True if aflatoxin_band == HIGH or confidence < 0.6.

surface_coverage_pct.description: Estimated % of image area with visible mould. MobileNetV3-seg, mIoU ≥ 0.72.

foreign_matter_detected.description: YOLO-nano foreign matter detection on macro images. F1 ≥ 0.88.

derived.description: Derived outputs computed from proximate + safety results.

feed_grade.description: Overall feed grade. A→green, B→blue, C→amber, REJECT→red.

feed_grade_reasons.description: Short machine-readable reason codes that determined the grade. e.g. ['urea_detected', 'cp_below_minimum', 'high_moisture']

value_for_money.description: Value comparison against local market rates. Null if price not entered.

storage_action.description: Plain-language storage advisory key, resolved to locale string in the UI. e.g. 'dry_within_3_days'

herd_context_id.description: The herd record used for ration balancing at time of test. Null if no herd profile set up.

advisory_id.description: UUIDv7 of the advisory record generated from this measurement.

price_paid_inr_per_kg.description: Optional: price the farmer paid. Enables value-for-money calculation.

spectrum_id.description: UUIDv7 of the raw spectrum record stored separately (large payload).

macro_image_ids.description: UUIDv7s of the 4-angle macro photo records stored separately.

confidence_overall.description: Ensemble confidence across all active models. < 0.6 triggers 'low confidence' UI warning.

in_distribution.description: False if Mahalanobis distance of the spectrum from training manifold exceeds threshold. If false, UI must show 'unusual sample — send to lab' and refuse to print a grade.

model_versions.description: Version string of each model bundle active during inference. For audit and retraining queue.

local_advisory_text.description: Keyed by Language enum. Pre-rendered advisory text stored with the record for offline display.

qr_batch_id.description: If this test was triggered by scanning a QR batch, the batch UUID. Enables declared-vs-measured diff.

NumericResult.description: A numeric measurement with confidence interval. Never display value without ci_low/ci_high.

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval.

ci_high.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this prediction. < 0.6 = low confidence.
